frontier.hypothesis: The last 2 insns - sh zero,0(gp) at ours idx 64 vs target idx 56 - are a pure sched.c list-scheduler priority question with no remaining source-order handle, and are reachable only by changing the store's INSN_PRIORITY or the ready-list rank relative to the (frac_s1*0x9C4)+(inv_s1*0x2710) synth-mult chain.
frontier.mechanism: A dependence-free store has no forward LOG_LINKS, so priority() gives it the floor value and rank_for_schedule sinks it below every chain insn in the ready list; target's build ranked it above them. Statement order is now exhaustively eliminated (85 moves, 19 ties at 2), and expression-shape changes in the same block only regress.
